Definition: Nechemjah, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Nehemiah = "Jehovah comforts"; 1) the son of Hachaliah, cupbearer to king Artaxerxes, who became governor of Judah after the return from exile; 2) one of the 12 heads of the people who returned from exile with Zerubbabel; 3) son of Azbuk and ruler of the half part of Beth-zur, who helped to repair the wall of Jerusalem
